buildings.name: Stronghold
buildings.description: The heart of your kingdom. Upgrade to unlock buildings and raise your power.

buildings.name: Farm
buildings.description: Feeds your people. Accumulates food over time — tap to collect.

buildings.name: Sawmill
buildings.description: Cuts timber for construction. Accumulates wood — tap to collect.

buildings.name: Quarry
buildings.description: Mines stone from the earth. Accumulates stone — tap to collect.

buildings.name: Treasury
buildings.description: Collects taxes from your subjects. Accumulates gold — tap to collect.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description: Trains Infantry troops. Upgrade to unlock higher-tier infantry.

buildings.name: Archery Range
buildings.description: Trains Archer troops. Upgrade to unlock higher-tier archers.

buildings.name: Stable
buildings.description: Trains Cavalry troops. Upgrade to unlock higher-tier cavalry.

buildings.name: Siege Workshop
buildings.description: Builds Siege engines. Upgrade to unlock higher-tier siege weapons.

buildings.name: Guardhouse
buildings.description: Marks your kingdom’s military readiness. Must stay one level behind the Stronghold for it to keep upgrading, and gates Barracks.

buildings.name: Academy
buildings.description: Unlocks the Research tree. Required to study all technology branches.

buildings.name: Drill Grounds
buildings.description: Train your armies to march and raid. Each level raises your march capacity by 200 troops.

buildings.name: Warehouse
buildings.description: Protects your resources from raiders. Resources stored below the protection threshold cannot be looted.

buildings.name: War Hall
buildings.description: Musters your guild's rallies. Each level raises the total troops a Rally you start can carry by 200.

buildings.name: Embassy
buildings.description: Hosts allied reinforcements. Each level raises the total troops your castle can hold as reinforcements by 200.

buildings.name: Lighthouse
buildings.description: Required to send scouts. Each level sharpens what a scout report reveals — which troop tiers you can identify, how exact the troop counts are, and (at high levels) the reinforcements stationed in the castle.

buildings.name: Hospital
buildings.description: Holds wounded troops and heals them. Each level raises how many wounded it can hold by 200 and makes healing 2% faster. Troops lost in battle are wounded first and only die if the Hospital is full.
